requirements.description: Three Card Poker applies the documented three-card ranking, queen-high dealer qualification, Ante Bonus A, Pair Plus C, and Play or Fold settlement rules.
requirements.notes: Allocated by GitHub issue #77 for issue #93; focused and real-backend tests cover ranking, qualification, bonuses, Play, Fold, wins, losses, and ties.

requirements.description: Authenticated sessions own isolated reload-safe Three Card Poker decisions, recent rounds, hidden dealer cards, and canonical route restoration.
requirements.notes: Session context overrides caller player ids, dealer cards stay hidden before settlement, and terminal history survives restart.

requirements.description: Ante, Pair Plus, Play, refund, and payout movements use the shared ledger exactly once under stable identifiers and immutable fingerprints.
requirements.notes: Game code never mutates balances directly; opening and decision retries preserve exact ledger proof while changed payloads fail closed.

requirements.description: The Three Card Poker surface provides complete English and Russian copy and remains responsive, accessible, and reduced-motion safe across required viewports and outcomes.
requirements.notes: Acceptance evidence covers both locales, all four named viewports, ready, decision, terminal, Fold, reduced-motion, and route-restored states.

requirements.description: Catalog, contract, browser, and long-suite discovery include Three Card Poker with requirement, module, version, and visual evidence traceability.
requirements.notes: The descriptor uses sort order 190 and the normalized tests.game_drivers.three_card_poker:play driver reference released by issue #77. Browser locale evidence waits for the exact installed-resource title instead of assuming a fixed resource-load duration.

requirements.description: Three Card Poker publishes deal preparation, request ownership, Play or Fold decisions, ledger proof, terminal settlement, and action-owned rollback through provider-current callbacks that replace only game-owned rounds, order, requests, and ledger markers. Competing processes preserve unrelated player-state siblings and fail closed before stale decisions can overwrite or resurrect a terminal round, while lost ledger responses reconcile immutable proof without repeating a debit or credit.
requirements.notes: The frozen v1 routes, cards, ranking, paytables, dealer privacy, and ledger vocabulary remain unchanged. Production multiworker activation stays blocked because state, ledger, and history remain separate transaction boundaries.
